# Cncf Google Kubernetes Engine Gke Reviewer

Review Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. GKE is an enterprise-grade platform for containerized applications, including stateful and stateless, AI and ML, Linux and Windows, complex and simple web apps, API, and backend services.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
